key: Uses Claude Code installed on this Mac and your Claude subscription login; requests count against its usage limits. Run `claude` once in Terminal to log in. Model: an alias (sonnet, opus) or a full id. Effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, or max (none and minimal become low).

translation: Usa Claude Code instalado en este Mac y el inicio de sesión de tu suscripción a Claude; las solicitudes cuentan para sus límites de uso. Ejecuta `claude` una vez en Terminal para iniciar sesión. Modelo: un alias (sonnet, opus) o un id completo. Esfuerzo: low, medium, high, xhigh o max (none y minimal pasan a low).

key: Uses Codex installed on this Mac and your ChatGPT login; requests count against your plan's usage limits. Run `codex login` once in Terminal to log in. Effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, or max. An empty model uses Codex's default.
english: Uses Codex installed on this Mac and your ChatGPT login; requests count against your plan's usage limits. Run `codex login` once in Terminal to log in. Effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, or max. An empty model uses Codex's default.
comment: Settings > AI caption. Keep commands in backticks, model aliases, effort values (low, medium, high, xhigh, max, none, minimal, auto), and product names untranslated.
translation: Usa Codex instalado en este Mac y tu inicio de sesión de ChatGPT; las solicitudes cuentan para los límites de uso de tu plan. Ejecuta `codex login` una vez en Terminal para iniciar sesión. Esfuerzo: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh o max. Si el modelo está vacío, se usa el predeterminado de Codex.

key: Uses the Antigravity CLI installed on this Mac and the Google account it is logged in with; requests count against that account's limits. Run `agy` once in Terminal to log in; `agy models` lists the model ids. Effort: low, medium, high, or max, only for a model id without its own level (a model ending in -high, -medium, or -low ignores it). Runs use agy's hearsay-notes project, whose deny rules leave the model no tools except web search, and each run's conversation is deleted from agy's history afterwards.
english: Uses the Antigravity CLI installed on this Mac and the Google account it is logged in with; requests count against that account's limits. Run `agy` once in Terminal to log in; `agy models` lists the model ids. Effort: low, medium, high, or max, only for a model id without its own level (a model ending in -high, -medium, or -low ignores it). Runs use agy's hearsay-notes project, whose deny rules leave the model no tools except web search, and each run's conversation is deleted from agy's history afterwards.
comment: Settings > AI caption. Keep commands in backticks, model aliases, effort values (low, medium, high, xhigh, max, none, minimal, auto), and product names untranslated.
translation: Usa la Antigravity CLI instalada en este Mac y la cuenta de Google con la que ha iniciado sesión; las solicitudes cuentan para los límites de esa cuenta. Ejecuta `agy` una vez en Terminal para iniciar sesión; `agy models` muestra los id de modelo. Esfuerzo: low, medium, high o max, solo para un id de modelo sin nivel propio (un modelo que termina en -high, -medium o -low lo ignora). Las ejecuciones usan el proyecto hearsay-notes de agy, cuyas reglas de denegación no dejan al modelo ninguna herramienta salvo la búsqueda web, y la conversación de cada ejecución se elimina después del historial de agy.

key: Uses the Copilot CLI installed on this Mac and its own login. Run `copilot` once in Terminal to log in. "auto" lets Copilot pick the model.

translation: %@ no está disponible para grabar. Vuelve a conectarlo o elige otra entrada.

english: %1$@ is not logged in. Run `%2$@` once in Terminal to log in with your ChatGPT account.
comment: Meeting notes error. %1$@ is a CLI name, %2$@ a shell command.
translation: %1$@ no ha iniciado sesión. Ejecuta `%2$@` una vez en Terminal para iniciar sesión con tu cuenta de ChatGPT.

key: %@ is not logged in. Run `%@` once in Terminal to log in with your Claude subscription.
english: %1$@ is not logged in. Run `%2$@` once in Terminal to log in with your Claude subscription.
comment: Meeting notes error. %1$@ is a CLI name, %2$@ a shell command.

key: %@ is not logged in. Run `%@` once in Terminal to log in with your Google account.
english: %1$@ is not logged in. Run `%2$@` once in Terminal to log in with your Google account.
comment: Meeting notes error. %1$@ is a CLI name, %2$@ a shell command.
translation: %1$@ no ha iniciado sesión. Ejecuta `%2$@` una vez en Terminal para iniciar sesión con tu cuenta de Google.

key: %@ is not logged in. Run `%@` once in Terminal to log in.
english: %1$@ is not logged in. Run `%2$@` once in Terminal to log in.
comment: Meeting notes error. %1$@ is a CLI name, %2$@ a shell command.
translation: %1$@ no ha iniciado sesión. Ejecuta `%2$@` una vez en Terminal para iniciar sesión.

key: %@ not found. Install it with `%@` or set the path in Settings > AI.
english: %1$@ not found. Install it with `%2$@` or set the path in Settings > AI.
comment: Meeting notes error. %1$@ is a CLI name (for example Codex CLI), %2$@ a shell command. Keep the backticks.
translation: No se encuentra %1$@. Instálalo con `%2$@` o define la ruta en Ajustes > IA.

comment: Meeting notes error. %@ is a CLI name.
CLI check result suffix. %@ is the subscription name (for example max).

key: AI output did not contain a usable filename.
english: AI output did not contain a usable filename.
translation: La salida de la IA no contenía un nombre de archivo válido.

key: AI output did not contain a usable structured transcript.
english: AI output did not contain a usable structured transcript.
translation: La salida de la IA no contenía una transcripción estructurada válida.

key: AI output did not contain usable Markdown notes.
english: AI output did not contain usable Markdown notes.
translation: La salida de la IA no contenía notas en Markdown válidas.

key: AI output is not valid JSON: %@
english: AI output is not valid JSON: %@
comment: Meeting notes error. %@ is a technical detail in English.
translation: La salida de la IA no es JSON válido: %@

key: AI output must be a JSON object.
english: AI output must be a JSON object.
translation: La salida de la IA debe ser un objeto JSON.

comment: Meeting notes error. %1$lld is an HTTP status code, %2$@ the server's message.

key: API HTTP Error %lld: The response body is empty.
english: API HTTP Error %lld: The response body is empty.
comment: Meeting notes error. %lld is an HTTP status code.
translation: Error HTTP de la API %lld: el cuerpo de la respuesta está vacío.

key: API call failed: A network connection or HTTP client error occurred. %@
english: API call failed: A network connection or HTTP client error occurred. %@
comment: Meeting notes error. %@ is the system error message.
translation: Error en la llamada a la API: se ha producido un error de conexión de red o del cliente HTTP. %@

key: All files keep their original names.
english: All files keep their original names.
comment: Follows a rename error: nothing was changed.
translation: Todos los archivos mantienen sus nombres originales.

comment: Recording error. %@ is a technical detail in English.
translation: Error en la captura de audio: %@

comment: Audio error. %@ is a technical detail in English.
translation: Error en la conversión de audio: %@

comment: Language picker segment: detect the spoken language automatically. Keep it short.
Confirm sheet 'Model:' when empty: the command-line tool picks its own model

key: Cannot reach %@. Check the base URL in Settings > AI and your network connection.
english: Cannot reach %@. Check the base URL in Settings > AI and your network connection.
comment: Meeting notes error. %@ is a host name.
translation: No se puede conectar con %@. Comprueba la URL base en Ajustes > IA y tu conexión de red.

comment: Provider preset name. Keep 'Claude Code CLI' and 'Claude' untranslated.
Provider preset name. Keep 'Codex CLI' and 'ChatGPT' untranslated.
Recording error. %1$@ is the input device name, %2$d a CoreAudio error number.
translation: No se ha podido seleccionar %1$@ (error de CoreAudio %2$d).

key: Could not set up the %@ project in %@: %@
english: Could not set up the %1$@ project in %2$@: %3$@
comment: Meeting notes error. %1$@ is a project name (keep it), %2$@ a folder path, %3$@ the system error message.
translation: No se ha podido configurar el proyecto %1$@ en %2$@: %3$@

key: Couldn't tell the language, so this was transcribed in %@ (your preferred language).
english: Couldn't tell the language, so this was transcribed in %@ (your preferred language).
comment: Language banner. %@ is a language name in its own language (English, 中文, Deutsch, Español).
translation: No se ha podido reconocer el idioma, así que se ha transcrito en %@ (tu idioma preferido).

comment: Provider preset name: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint the user enters
Settings > Window: show Hearsay only in the Dock
Model download error. %1$@ is a file name, %2$lld an HTTP status code.
translation: La descarga de %1$@ ha fallado con el estado HTTP %2$lld.

key: Error: The SRT contains no transcript content to summarize.
english: Error: The SRT contains no transcript content to summarize.
translation: Error: El SRT no contiene ninguna transcripción que resumir.

comment: Name of the built-in prompt template (Settings > AI, confirm sheet)

key: GitHub Copilot CLI call failed (exit code %d). Check the Copilot login status and model configuration.
english: GitHub Copilot CLI call failed (exit code %d). Check the Copilot login status and model configuration.
comment: Meeting notes error. %d is the exit code.
translation: Error en la llamada a GitHub Copilot CLI (código de salida %d). Comprueba el estado de inicio de sesión de Copilot y la configuración del modelo.

key: GitHub Copilot CLI call failed. Check the Copilot login status and model configuration: %@
english: GitHub Copilot CLI call failed. Check the Copilot login status and model configuration: %@
comment: Meeting notes error. %@ is a technical detail.
translation: Error en la llamada a GitHub Copilot CLI. Comprueba el estado de inicio de sesión de Copilot y la configuración del modelo: %@

key: Hearsay has no microphone access. Allow it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone.
english: Hearsay has no microphone access. Allow it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone.
comment: Recording error. Use the macOS wording for the System Settings path.
translation: Hearsay no tiene acceso al micrófono. Permítelo en Ajustes del Sistema > Privacidad y seguridad > Micrófono.

key: Hearsay has no system audio access. Allow it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording, then start a new recording.
english: Hearsay has no system audio access. Allow it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording, then start a new recording.
comment: Recording error. Use the macOS wording for the System Settings path.
translation: Hearsay no tiene acceso al audio del sistema. Permítelo en Ajustes del Sistema > Privacidad y seguridad > Grabación de pantalla y audio del sistema y, a continuación, inicia una nueva grabación.

comment: Shortcut display for a key with no printed name. The placeholder is the numeric key code.
Token error. %@ is the message macOS gives for the Keychain error.
CLI check result. %@ is the login method reported by Claude Code.
CLI check result. %lld is the number of models (never 1).
Settings > Window: show Hearsay in the menu bar and the Dock
Settings > Window: show Hearsay only in the menu bar
translation: Solo en la barra de menús

key: No API token is set for this provider. Add one in Settings > AI.
english: No API token is set for this provider. Add one in Settings > AI.
comment: Meeting notes error. 'Settings > AI' names the Settings tab and section.
translation: No hay ningún token de API configurado para este proveedor. Añade uno en Ajustes > IA.

key: No audio from %@. Nothing arrived within %lld seconds, so the recording was stopped. Check that the device is connected and not muted, or choose another input.
english: No audio from %1$@. Nothing arrived within %2$lld seconds, so the recording was stopped. Check that the device is connected and not muted, or choose another input.
comment: Recording error. %1$@ is the input device name, %2$lld a number of seconds.
translation: No llega audio de %1$@. No ha llegado nada en %2$lld segundos, así que se ha detenido la grabación. Comprueba que el dispositivo esté conectado y no silenciado, o elige otra entrada.

key: No display is available to capture system audio from.
english: No display is available to capture system audio from.
translation: No hay ninguna pantalla disponible para capturar el audio del sistema.
No hay ningún dispositivo de entrada disponible.

comment: Settings > AI > Token header picker: send no token
Audio error. %@ is a file path.
translation: No es un archivo WAV legible: %@

comment: CLI check result. %@ is the 'Run … once in Terminal to log in.' hint.
Confirm sheet caption. %@ is a language name in its own language.
Meeting notes error. %@ is the reason, one of the 'AI output ...' messages.

key: Parsing Error: API response did not contain usable message content.
english: Parsing Error: API response did not contain usable message content.
translation: Error de análisis: la respuesta de la API no contenía contenido de mensaje válido.

key: Parsing Error: The API response is not valid JSON: %@
english: Parsing Error: The API response is not valid JSON: %@
comment: Meeting notes error. %@ is the start of the server's reply.
translation: Error de análisis: la respuesta de la API no es JSON válido: %@

key: Run `%@` once in Terminal to log in.
english: Run `%@` once in Terminal to log in.
comment: CLI check hint. %@ is a shell command; keep the backticks.
translation: Ejecuta `%@` una vez en Terminal para iniciar sesión.

key: Run `copilot` once in Terminal to log in.
english: Run `copilot` once in Terminal to log in.
comment: Meeting notes error hint. Keep `copilot` and the backticks.
translation: Ejecuta `copilot` una vez en Terminal para iniciar sesión.

key: System audio capture could not start: %@
english: System audio capture could not start: %@
comment: Recording error. %@ is a technical detail from macOS.
translation: No se ha podido iniciar la captura del audio del sistema: %@

comment: Recording error. %@ is a technical detail from macOS.
translation: Se ha detenido la captura del audio del sistema: %@

key: The %@ preset does not use a command-line tool.
english: The %@ preset does not use a command-line tool.
comment: Meeting notes error. %@ is a provider preset name.
translation: El preajuste %@ no usa ninguna herramienta de línea de comandos.

key: The API URL is not a valid http or https address. Check it in Settings > AI.
english: The API URL is not a valid http or https address. Check it in Settings > AI.
translation: La URL de la API no es una dirección http o https válida. Compruébala en Ajustes > IA.

key: The WAV file is already closed.
english: The WAV file is already closed.
translation: El archivo WAV ya está cerrado.

key: The built-in model list could not be read: %@
english: The built-in model list could not be read: %@
comment: Models tab error. %@ is the system error message.
translation: No se ha podido leer la lista de modelos integrada: %@

comment: Follows a Trash error: the old notes are still in place.

key: The input device changed or was disconnected, so recording stopped.
english: The input device changed or was disconnected, so recording stopped.
translation: El dispositivo de entrada ha cambiado o se ha desconectado, así que se ha detenido la grabación.

key: The login status check did not answer.
english: The login status check did not answer.
translation: La comprobación del estado de inicio de sesión no ha respondido.

key: The meeting name contains no usable characters. Use English letters or digits.
english: The meeting name contains no usable characters. Use English letters or digits.
comment: Naming error. File names use English letters and digits only.
translation: El nombre de la reunión no contiene caracteres válidos. Usa letras o dígitos del alfabeto inglés.

key: The server did not return an HTTP response.
english: The server did not return an HTTP response.
comment: Meeting notes error detail, shown after 'API call failed: …'
translation: El servidor no ha devuelto una respuesta HTTP.

comment: Model download error. %@ is a file name.

key: The server sent an unexpected response for %@.
english: The server sent an unexpected response for %@.
comment: Model download error. %@ is a file name.
translation: El servidor ha enviado una respuesta inesperada para %@.

key: The transcript, recording and any earlier notes keep their original names.
english: The transcript, recording and any earlier notes keep their original names.
comment: Follows a write error: nothing was renamed.
translation: La transcripción, la grabación y las notas anteriores mantienen sus nombres originales.

key: These files could not be restored: %@.
english: These files could not be restored: %@.
comment: Follows a file error. %@ is a comma-separated list of file paths.
translation: No se han podido restaurar estos archivos: %@.

key: This sounds like %@. Transcribe again in %@?
english: This sounds like %1$@. Transcribe again in %2$@?
comment: Language banner. Both %@ are the same language name in its own language (English, 中文, Deutsch, Español).
translation: Esto suena a %1$@. ¿Volver a transcribir en %2$@?

comment: Confirm sheet caption. %@ is a language name, possibly followed by an explanation in parentheses.

key: Unable to move the current notes (%@) to the Trash: %@.
english: Unable to move the current notes (%1$@) to the Trash: %2$@.
comment: Regenerate notes error. %1$@ is a file path, %2$@ the system error message.
translation: No se han podido trasladar las notas actuales (%1$@) a la Papelera: %2$@.

comment: Naming error. %1$@ is a file path, %2$@ a file name, %3$@ the system error message.
translation: No se ha podido renombrar %1$@ como %2$@: %3$@.

comment: Naming error. %1$@ is a file path, %2$@ the system error message.
translation: No se han podido escribir las notas de la reunión (%1$@): %2$@.

comment: Audio error. %@ is a technical detail in English.
CLI check result. %1$d is the exit code, %2$@ the log-in hint. Keep `agy models`.
Bundle display name. Product name: keep "Hearsay" untranslated. Do not translate: repeat the English exactly.

english: Hearsay captures the audio of your calls so both sides of a meeting are transcribed.
comment: Privacy - Audio Capture Usage Description. macOS shows it when Hearsay first asks to capture system audio (the other side of a call).
translation: Hearsay captura el audio de tus llamadas para que se transcriban ambas partes de una reunión.

english: Hearsay records meetings you start and transcribes them on this Mac.
comment: Privacy - Microphone Usage Description. macOS shows it when Hearsay first asks for the microphone.
translation: Hearsay graba las reuniones que inicias y las transcribe en este Mac.
